Question Choices: X is binomial with n=3 and p=0.4. Find p(1).

Which formula is the binomial pmf for k successes in n independent p-Bernoulli trials? Choices: A) C(n,k)·p^k·(1-p)^(n-k) | B) (1-p)^(k-1)·p | C) p^k | D) C(m,k)·C(N-m,n-k)/C(N,n) Answer with the letter only.
Hints: Choose which k trials succeed, then multiply the probabilities
Solution: The binomial pmf is $\binom{n}{k}p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$. The answer is A.
